metadata.project_name: Liver Disease Risk Prediction: Classical ML Pipeline
metadata.citation: Ramana, B., & Venkateswarlu, N. (2012). ILPD (Indian Liver Patient Dataset) [Dataset]. UCI Machine Learning Repository. https://doi.org/10.24432/C5D02C

bootstrap_ci_95.note: Because test set sample size is relatively small (N=114), confidence intervals are inherently wider than in large epidemiological studies.

shap.clinical_assessment: Clinical Sense Assessment: Top contributing features (such as Total Bilirubin, Direct Bilirubin, Alkaline Phosphatase, and Transaminases SGOT/SGPT) are well-established biomarkers of hepatic injury, cholestasis, and hepatocellular necrosis in routine hepatic function panels. However, statistical feature importance in a predictive pipeline MUST NOT be conflated with clinical etiology or causal mechanism. Observational correlations reflect biomarker associations in this cohort and cannot replace comprehensive clinical diagnosis.
shap.causal_disclaimer: Feature importance is associative, not causal. This is an educational experiment.
